title: Valentine Kindness: Making a Homemade Card for Everyone!

lines.text: Valentine's Day at school! Red glitter, heart stickers, and pink paper everywhere!
lines.caps: Valentine's Day at *SCHOOL! | Red glitter, heart stickers, and *PINK | paper *EVERYWHERE!

lines.text: Leo made bright cards for all his soccer buddies, laughing and sharing candy!
lines.caps: Leo made cards for all his *BUDDIES, | laughing and sharing *SWEET | *CANDY!

lines.text: Then he noticed Toby, the shy new boy, quietly coloring alone by the window!
lines.caps: Then he noticed *TOBY, | the shy new boy, quietly coloring *ALONE | by the *WINDOW!

lines.text: Toby's Valentine mailbox was completely empty—not even a single sticker inside!
lines.caps: Toby's Valentine *MAILBOX | was completely empty—not a single *STICKER | *INSIDE!

lines.text: Leo stopped. True kindness means making sure no friend gets left behind!
lines.caps: Leo stopped. True *KINDNESS | means making sure no friend gets left *BEHIND!

lines.text: He grabbed his gold marker and drew a smiling rocket: To Toby, coolest builder in class!
lines.caps: He drew a smiling *ROCKET: | To Toby, coolest builder in our whole *CLASS!

lines.text: When Toby opened the card, his face lit up brighter than a million fireworks!
lines.caps: When Toby opened the *CARD, | his face lit up brighter than *FIREWORKS!

lines.text: A tiny act of kindness can turn someone's lonely day into pure magic!
lines.caps: A tiny act of *KINDNESS | can turn someone's lonely day into pure *MAGIC!

lines.text: Spread warmth everywhere—subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo!
